body:
Accepted scoped prerequisite for #130 schema work, 2026-10-10 (Cloud integration owner decision).

After current #129/#130 contract review and the merged PR #250 design probe, the following interface boundary is accepted for bounded Package Revision schema/fixture implementation:

- Full Package Revision references identify Workspace, logical Package and immutable revision; Runtime Plan references identify the owning Package Revision and immutable plan digest/schema/compatibility identity.
- These are scoped service references. Portable Package Revision content must not acquire installation-specific Workspace IDs, deployed binding values, credentials or machine-local paths merely because a consumer carries a scoped reference.
- Package declarations contain logical binding requirements; Deployment supplies authorized binding references and values remain outside package content.
- Selection is explicit among declared plans, with no implicit adapter fallback. #83 retains ownership of persisted Run/retry pinning; #143 retains dynamic adapter admission and payload conformance.

This accepts only the prerequisite envelope for #130 schema/fixtures. It does not approve the entire paused #129 DDL/API proposal, claim a production resolver/Run pin, close #129, or bypass #134 RCC-first consumer proof. #135 compilation and #136 provider/registry gates remain separate. The existing Devsy coordinator owns the bounded #130 implementation assignment; no competing writer is being launched.

Review source: PR #250, merged at `3ed98ddbac3354c59414b8411b295db2e15d3545`; current issue-body SHA-256 values #129 `8b0b49ade2f5cd29dfa9dab0babc91c2fd7ebd36098ed3fad7ac32daaf9f7ff5`, #130 `5fea0f4828c20faa32298d60083ca684b3b8225f0af6baea0d8fa4363dae4277`. The dated canonical graph amendment retains all original contracts and records this criterion separately from whole-issue acceptance.
